newsitem.title: FRANCE: French police find girls' bodies after carnival.
newsitem.headline: French police find girls' bodies after carnival.

text.p: French police on Friday found the bodies of four young women who went missing during a carnival evening 10 days ago in the northern port of Boulogne.

Investigators said suspects had confessed to the murder of the girls, whose bodies were found concealed at the base of a concrete blockhouse built by German forces during World War Two in a forest outside the village of Portel, near Boulogne.

The four young women -- 20 year-olds Isabelle and Peggy, and 17-year-olds Audrey and Amelie -- were wearing fancy carnival dresses when they went missing. They were allegedly murdered on the evening following their disappearance, police said.
Five members of one family were detained by police.
The suspects included three brothers, all of them scrap merchants, who live in a village a few km (miles) from the spot where the women were seen for the last time, police said.
